A traditional blacksmithing scene. Under a thatched roof shelter, a bare-chested blacksmith is sitting, using a heavy iron hammer to beat a glowing red piece of metal on a stone anvil. Beside him, an apprentice is working a pair of skin bellows connected to clay pipes, blowing air into a small, bright charcoal fire. Finished iron hoes and spearheads lean against a wooden post.
